overview: Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up handbook for men, becoming a bestselling author in the process.
tagline: When it comes to getting dumped... He wrote the book.

recs.blurb: A man crippled by the mundanity of his life experiences something out of the ordinary.
Two plus-sized ladies meet the men of their dreams in the most unexpected of ways.
Five years after jilting his pregnant fiancée on their wedding day, out-of-shape Dennis decides to run a marathon to win her back.
A shallow man falls in love with a 300 pound woman because of her "inner beauty".
A lighthearted story about a man and a woman who seem destined to be together... and the hilarious chain of accidents that seem determined to keep them apart!
Ten stories, each inspired by one of the ten commandments.
The story of Nola Darling's simultaneous sexual relationships with three different men is told by her and by her partners and other friends. All three men…
A lonely, sexually repressed man. A depressed woman. A summer camp. On this fateful night, they will meet... and their hearts will become one.
Believing himself to be a jinx and bringing bad luck upon himself and others, a man attempts to find true love, but ends up in very complicated relationships.
After losing his job, a middle-aged man reinvents himself by going back to college.
Both dumped by their girlfriends, two best friends seek refuge in the local mall.
The continuing adventures of the Portokalos family. A follow-up to the 2002 comedy, "My Big Fat Greek Wedding."
